name: Varazze (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, the white with a red Greek cross throughout and the green charged with a white letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Varazze, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: cross throughout the white upper half
letter V on the green lower half
